map.📚 深度解析：急性胰腺炎 Glasgow(Imrie) 严重度评分: 📚 Deep Dive: Acute Pancreatitis Glasgow(Imrie) Severity Score
map.入院评估：48 小时内按 9 项指标算 Glasgow 评分判轻/重/危重: Admission assessment: compute the Glasgow score from 9 indicators within 48 hours to judge mild/severe/critical
map.ICU 决策：≥3 分提示重症，需监护与器官支持: ICU decision: ≥3 points indicates severe disease requiring monitoring and organ support
map.动态复查：48 小时内复算捕捉病情恶化: Dynamic recheck: recompute within 48 hours to catch deterioration
map.算法（9 项，各 +1）：年龄 >55 岁；白细胞 >15×10⁹/L；血糖 >: Algorithm (9 items, each +1): age >55 years; WBC >15×10⁹/L; glucose >10 mmol/L; LDH >600 U/L; AST >200 U/L; calcium <2.0 mmol/L; albumin <32 g/L; urea >16 mmol/L; PaO2 <60 mmHg. Total 0~9: <3 mild (mortality <3%), 3~5 severe (15~30%), ≥6 critical (>50%).
map.例：年龄 60、WBC 16、血糖 11、LDH 620、AST 210、钙 1: Example: age 60, WBC 16, glucose 11, LDH 620, AST 210, calcium 1.9, albumin 30, urea 18, PaO2 55 → all 9 items triggered, score 9, critical (mortality >50%), requires ICU resuscitation. If age 60, WBC 16, glucose 11, LDH 620, others normal (AST 200, calcium 2.0, albumin 32, urea 16, PaO2 60) → only 4 items triggered, score 4, severe (15~30%); ICU monitoring and dynamic CT are advised.
map.Glasgow 和 APACHE II 怎么选？: How to choose between Glasgow and APACHE II?
map.Glasgow(Imrie) 只用 9 项常规化验，简便、入院即可算，适合快速分: Glasgow(Imrie) uses only 9 routine labs, is simple and can be computed on admission, suiting quick triage; APACHE II has more indicators and a more complete overall critical illness assessment. Clinically the two are often used together, while the Ranson criteria emphasize admission and 48h dynamic indicators.
map.评分 2 分但临床很重怎么办？: What if the score is 2 but the patient looks very ill?
map.评分仅反映入院 48h 内实验室异常，不能替代临床判断。若出现持续器官衰竭、腹腔: The score only reflects lab abnormalities within the first 48 hours and cannot replace clinical judgment. If persistent organ failure, abdominal compartment syndrome, or CT showing extensive necrosis appears, severe management with dynamic rescoring is warranted even when the score is low.
